analysis:
In a suo-motu statement in the Rajya Sabha on 15 March 2022, Jaishankar said that about 22,500 citizens had returned home safely under Operation Ganga.

The Ministry of External Affairs told Parliament that around 22,500 Indian nationals were evacuated from Ukraine in February-March 2022, with 90 evacuation flights (76 commercial and 14 Indian Air Force).

Other MEA replies give 18,278-18,282 as the number brought back specifically from Ukraine by the 90 flights, while the higher figure of about 22,500 covers all returns in the period. The minister's figure is consistent with the official numbers.
notes: MEA replies contain two different numbers (about 22,500 total evacuated vs 18,278-18,282 returned by the 90 Operation Ganga flights). The YouTube URL was found in search results; exact timestamp not verified.
